Headquarters: US Remote

Meet Yubico

Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.

Why Join Our Mission?

At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:

• Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.

• Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.

• One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.

Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program.
At Yubico, we offer:

Freedom and Flexibility: At Yubico, we want you to be your most productive selves whether you decide to work 100% from home or choose to work hybrid/onsite. The way we balance the fast-paced demands of a high-growth company and sustainability is making rest a priority.

Yubico Values: We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico which all employees are welcome to join. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work here).

Social Connection: Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our Life at Yubico Page on LinkedIn and our awards here.

The Role:

Yubico is seeking a Channel Manager to manage and expand relationships with key cybersecurity resellers and strategic partners, including GuidePoint, Zones, and Insight. This individual will be responsible for driving revenue growth through partner enablement, joint business planning, and strategic execution. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of the cybersecurity VAR ecosystem, thrives in a collaborative environment, and can translate strategy into measurable results.

Tasks & Responsibilities:

• Strategic Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, building trusted relationships and ensuring alignment on joint business objectives.

• Joint Business Planning: Develop and execute annual business plans with assigned partners to drive growth, enablement, and solution adoption.

• Sales Enablement: Deliver targeted training and enablement programs to partner sales teams, equipping them with the knowledge and tools to effectively position Yubico’s security solutions.

• Deal Acceleration: Collaborate with partner sellers to identify, qualify, and close opportunities, supporting forecast accuracy and accelerating sales cycles.

• Performance Management: Track partner performance against revenue and engagement KPIs, identifying gaps and implementing improvement plans.

• Market & Competitive Insight: Monitor market trends and competitor activity to inform go-to-market strategies and strengthen Yubico’s channel value proposition.

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (MBA a plus)

• 5+ years of experience in channel management, partner development, or sales within cybersecurity or enterprise technology

• Demonstrated success driving revenue growth through strategic initiatives and partner collaboration

• Strong understanding of VAR, MSP, and distributor business models

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with experience engaging senior-level stakeholders

• Data-driven, with the ability to analyze performance metrics and translate them into actionable insights

• Self-starter with strong organizational skills and a results-oriented mindset

• Travel up to 40-50% required

Preferred Qualifications:

• Direct experience managing GuidePoint, Zones, or Optiv (or similar large cybersecurity resellers)

• Familiarity with identity and access management (IAM), multi-factor authentication (MFA), or broader cybersecurity markets

Our U. S. benefits are designed for your overall well-being:

Health coverage. We’ve got you covered with top of the line health plans, including dental and vision. We pay 100% of your premium and 85% for your family.

Retirement plan. Our retirement plan includes a 401K dollar per dollar match up to 6% with a cap of $6K/year. Immediate vesting.

Wellness reimbursement. We offer $1,200.00 in wellness earnings (prorated based on start date) that you can use on your gym membership, a massage, or your favorite online fitness classes. This is a taxable benefit if you choose to participate.

Learning and development. We encourage your professional growth and offer a yearly development stipend of $3,000 and mentorship program. 

Time off. We offer a total of 15 vacation days plus 10 holidays, and 7 sick days a year.

Paid parental leave. We love welcoming new family members to our YubiTeam! All parents receive 8 weeks of paid leave. Birthing parents receive an additional 8 weeks of paid leave (16 weeks total). 

Commuter Benefits. If you need to commute to the office, we offer commuter benefits. 

Strong mission & company values. We’re a global team on a global mission to make the internet more secure for everyone. We believe that every person’s work matters. That you should always be nice, stay humble, and have fun, and never take yourself too seriously.

2d3d9b3594bcf2b1.description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.
The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

Read this part first
Somewhere out there is a sourcer who is better than their job title says they are. They hit their numbers at a company that never let them talk to a hiring manager. They found the candidate nobody else found and watched a recruiter take the credit. They have been told to be patient, to wait for the next cycle, to earn it.
We are not going to make you wait.

What we do
We build autonomous aircraft and Legion, the software that flies hundreds of them as one coordinated swarm. Series A, backed by Khosla Ventures, and Coatue. We are hiring software engineers and aircraft engineers at the same time, which is hard, and how fast we hire is one of the few things standing between the current aircraft and the next one.
That is not a motivational line. It is the actual constraint. Recruiting is on the critical path here, and you will be able to see your work in the flight schedule.

The job
You own top of funnel for our software engineering roles: backend, frontend, autonomy, forward deployed. You will be reading GitHub profiles, writing outreach that engineers answer, and building searches that keep producing after the obvious names are gone.
Then the interesting part. Inside your first year you move onto the aircraft side: propulsion, structures, avionics, manufacturing, production. Almost nobody sources both. The people who can are rare enough that it changes what your career looks like from that point forward. We will teach you, and you will be bad at it for a while, and then you will not be.

What you get here that you did not get there
• 
Your own reqs, early, with your name on the outcome
• 
Hiring managers in the same building, not behind an intake form
• 
The freedom to change the message when it is not working, without asking three people first
• 
Someone who runs sourcing searches themselves every day and will look at your search strings with you
• 
A skill set at the end of two years that maybe a few hundred people in the country have

What we need from you
• 
1+ years of sourcing or recruiting, most of it in software engineering
• 
A hire you are proud of, one nobody else was going to find, and the ability to walk us through exactly how you found them
• 
A high tolerance for silence, because most of your outreach will go unanswered and the job is making the next message better anyway
• 
Real curiosity about how aircraft get built, or at least the honesty to say you find it interesting and want in
• 
Writing that sounds like a person, since your entire work product is text a stranger decides to open or delete
• 
Clean data habits, because our reporting goes to the CEO and it needs to be right

What we do not need
Ten years of experience. A recruiting pedigree. A degree in anything specific. Permission from your current manager to be good at this.

The honest version
 The pace is uncomfortable. You will be asked to fill roles you do not understand yet, and the answer will usually be to go learn them rather than to wait for a briefing.
If you want a clear ladder and a quiet quarter, this is the wrong job. If you have been waiting for someone to hand you something real, this is the shot.

ITAR requirement
To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer
• 
Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company
• 
Competitive base salary commensurate with experience
• 
Medical, dental, vision, and 401k
• 
PTO and paid sick leave
• 
Monthly wellness stipend
• 
Daily catered lunch (office)
• 
Paid parental leave
• 
Direct impact on a critical national security mission
• 
A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems
Compensation: $120K – $160K • Offers Equity

2d8960144272448a.description: FOUNDING PRE-SALES ENGINEER (AI & DECISION INTELLIGENCE) Company: ContexQ Location: Singapore / Remote At ContexQ, we are fundamentally reshaping the emerging landscape of Contextual Decision Intelligence. We leverage cutting-edge composite AI and graph technology to resolve entities continuously, uncovering hidden insights that revolutionize how enterprises handle fraud detection, financial crime (AML), risk management, and supply chain intelligence. We are an ambitious, fast-moving startup taking on massive enterprise challenges, and we are looking for a Founding Pre-Sales Engineer to be the technical tip of the spear. This is not a traditional corporate role. We are looking for an elite technologist with the DNA of an entrepreneur—someone who can command a boardroom, whiteboard complex AI architectures, and drive multi-million-dollar enterprise deals across the finish line. You will not just be selling software; you will be architecting the future of decision intelligence for global leaders in Financial Services, Manufacturing, E-commerce, and Public Sectors. THE MISSION As our Founding Pre-Sales Engineer, you are the bridge between our composite AI engineering and the customer’s most critical pain points. You will partner directly with the founding and sales teams to capture market share, translating complex technical capabilities into undeniable business value. Your ultimate metric is the technical win and the revenue that follows it. You will architect solutions, lead high-stakes proof-of-concepts (POCs), and create the "awe factor" that makes C-suite executives realize they cannot operate without ContexQ. WHAT YOU WILL DO • Drive the Technical Win: Own the technical stages of the enterprise sales cycle. Lead discovery sessions, architect bespoke solutions, and deliver high-impact product demonstrations that clearly map ContexQ's composite AI to the customer's specific risk and compliance challenges. • Execute Flawless POCs: Design, build, and deploy Proof of Concepts that prove our value proposition in the customer's environment, using their data to demonstrate ROI in real-time. • Shape the Product: Act as the voice of the market. Feed critical, frontline intelligence back to our R&D and product teams to directly influence the roadmap and enhance our graph AI capabilities. • Build the Engine: As a founding member of the go-to-market team, you will help design the playbooks, reference architectures, and technical enablement materials that will scale our pre-sales organization. • Accelerate Revenue: Partner ruthlessly with sales to qualify leads, navigate complex enterprise procurement processes, and close deals. WHO YOU ARE • The Rare Hybrid: You possess deep technical fluency (data architecture, AI/ML concepts, APIs, and cloud infrastructure) combined with elite commercial instincts. You know how to read a room and when to dive into the code versus when to focus on business outcomes. • Enterprise Battle-Tested: You have a proven track record of securing technical wins in complex, high-stakes B2B software sales—ideally within data analytics, AI, cybersecurity, or FinTech. • A Builder & Owner: You thrive in ambiguity. You don’t need a massive support team to execute; you are ready to roll up your sleeves, build the plane while flying it, and take extreme ownership of your pipeline. • A Master Communicator: You can explain highly complex graph AI and composite AI concepts to a non-technical CRO just as effectively as you can debate architecture with a seasoned CTO. COMPENSATION & THE CONTEXQ UPSIDE We are explicitly looking for top-tier talent who wants to bet on themselves and act as true owners. We structure compensation to heavily reward high performance, directly linking your financial success to your ability to drive revenue and capture market share. In exchange for your talent and grit, we offer significant foundational equity and a highly leveraged, uncapped commission structure tied to the deals you help close. This role is designed for a rainmaker who wants real skin in the game. If you are looking for a comfortable corporate base salary to coast on, this isn't for you. If you want the massive financial upside of building an enterprise AI juggernaut from the ground up and sharing directly in the revenue you generate, you belong at ContexQ.

Job Summary

We are seeking a hands-on, high-impact Senior Technical Architect (Platform Backend) to lead the architecture, scaling, and continuous evolution of our core platform infrastructure. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of high-throughput transactional systems and cloud-native architecture. You will be responsible for driving high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), establishing engineering guardrails, optimizing complex data pathways, and collaborating directly with product and engineering leaders to ensure absolute reliability, performance, and low latency at scale.

Key Responsibilities:

System Design & Architectural Leadership:

  • Own the end-to-end High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) for core platform services, asynchronous processing components, and enterprise ERP/bank integration adapters.
  • Facilitate a smooth transition from monolithic legacy boundaries into clean, highly cohesive microservices domains without impacting uptime or data integrity.
  • Establish architectural governance, lead Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and review critical pull requests to safeguard code quality, clean architecture principles, and SOLID design patterns.

Scalability, Performance & Reliability:

  • Architect multi-tenant, cloud-native frameworks capable of handling high-concurrency and petabyte-scale financial transactions with strict SLAs.
  • Diagnose and eliminate system bottlenecks across distributed transactions, locking models, memory management, and network payloads.
  • Oversee zero-trust security compliance, fault-tolerance mechanisms, automated failover policies, and disaster recovery readiness.

Data & Integration Architecture:

  • Design robust relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and non-relational database schemas, complex indexing strategies, data partitioning models, and archival frameworks.
  • Scale event-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka or similar messaging systems to manage reliable real-time data streaming and asynchronous decoupling.
  • Optimize high-throughput caching architectures (using Redis) to minimize database overhead for intensive financial computations.

Engineering Culture & Execution:

  • Act as a technical multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, driving proof-of-concepts (PoCs) for emerging technologies, and cultivating an environment of fast, first-principles execution.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management to scope technical roadmaps, decompose epic requirements into modular milestones, and proactively mitigate technical debt.

Required Skills

A technically deep engineering/product leader with:

  • Experience: 12 - 16 years of professional software engineering experience, with a minimum of 3 years successfully operating in a Technical Architect or Principal Engineer capacity for enterprise SaaS products.
  • Core Backend Stack: Expert-level mastery of Java (Java 17+), Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and enterprise-grade backend frameworks. A profound understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, multi-threading, and high-concurrency programming models.
  • Distributed Systems & Messaging: Proven experience in building distributed microservices, RESTful APIs, gRPC, and event-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Database & Storage Expertise: Advanced proficiency in SQL and NoSQL storage engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis). Hands-on capability with query execution plans, partitioning, and database tuning under heavy write/read loads.
  • Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure: Solid production experience with AWS (or Azure/GCP), containerization technologies (Docker), cluster orchestration (Kubernetes), and enterprise CI/CD deployment pipelines.
